description.zh:
返回结果中数据记录的排序方式，取值：

- **0**：倒序。
- **1**：正序。
description.en:
The sorting order of data records in the return result. Valid values:
- **0**: Descending order.
- **1**: Ascending order.

description.zh:
设备的名称。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
description.en:
The name of the device.  
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.  
></notice>

description.zh:
设备ID。
><notice> **IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
description.en:
Device ID.
><notice> **IotId** is the Unique Identifier of the device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** combination, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

description.zh: 实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。
description.en: Instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

description.zh: 下一页标识。如果存在下一页，服务会返回此token，下次请求带上即可。
description.en: The token that identifies the next page. If a next page exists, the service returns this token. Include it in your next request.

description.zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数，最多不可超过50条。
description.en: The number of records displayed per page in the return result. The maximum value is 50.

description.zh:
设备所属的产品**ProductKey**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

description.zh:
要查询数据所属自定义Topic。从`user`类目开始，输入自定义Topic的后续所有类目。

自定义Topic详细说明，请参见[自定义Topic](~~85539~~)。
description.en:
The custom topic to which the queried data belongs. Start from the `user` category and enter all subsequent categories of the custom topic.

For more information about custom topics, see [custom topic](~~85539~~).

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
仅华东2（上海）、华北2（北京）和华南1（深圳）地域的标准型和尊享型企业版实例下，支持调用该接口查询热数据。

热数据存储详细说明，请参见[配置热数据存储](~~464047~~)。

## 使用限制
调用该接口的每秒请求写入数据数，由您购买实例下的**热数据存储IOPS**规格决定。详细内容，请参见[购买企业版实例](~~356507~~)和[查看热数据存储IOPS](~~464051~~)。
descriptions.en:
## How-To
You can invoke this API to query hot data only for medium and premium Enterprise instances in the China (Shanghai), China (Beijing), and China (Shenzhen) regions.

For more information about hot data storage, see [Configure Hot Data Storage](~~464047~~).

## Limits
The number of data write requests per second allowed when invoking this API is determined by the **hot data storage input/output operations per second (IOPS)** specification of your purchased instance. For more information, see [Purchase an Enterprise Instance](~~356507~~) and [View Hot Data Storage IOPS](~~464051~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-devices-hot-storage-data-status --iot-instance-id iot-2w0000 --page-size 10 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name device1 --next-page-token Bo000x44Qx --asc 0 --iot-id y4u2weAI00000000HMle1234 --user-topic user/a000/b000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot QueryDevicesHotStorageDataStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Asc 0 --IotId y4u2weAI00000000HMle1234 --IotInstanceId 'iot-2w0000' --PageSize 10 --UserTopic 'user/a000/b000' --NextPageToken Bo000x44Qx --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName device1
